In Americano, players compete in random teams with the goal of accumulating as many points as possible, with each ball won being a point. After the specified number of balls, the results are recorded and each player gets a new teammate. The tournament is not finished until all players have played with all participants at least once and the player with the most points wins.

All players are initially placed in randomly selected teams, after which the teams are determined by each player's performance. Each ball won gives one point to the winning team. How to play Mixicano?
Mixicano is played just like Americano, although each team must consist of a woman and a man.
